items.question: Which remembered attributes define this reddish winged form that knows vina-playing truth?
premises: The form is remembered as knowing vina-playing truth.
The form is described as winged.
The form is described as reddish.
items.inference: Therefore the remembered form combines musical knowledge, wings, and red color.
uncertainties: The exact deity or bharga form is not fully specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: He is remembered as knowing the truth of vina playing, winged and reddish.
